mechanisms.mechanism: Events are counted from the header of the log on, and Codex writes the prompt into the log right after the header. A line of the prompt that looks like an event is counted: ` succeeded in 1.2s:` as a shell command that ran, `mcp: name started` as a tool call. A task file that quotes a Codex log can so make `shell_usable=yes` for a review in which no sandboxed command ran, the case the loop must stop on.
mechanisms.trigger: A prompt whose task file holds the lines `exec` and ` succeeded in 1.2s:`, and a review in which no command ran after the prompt.
mechanisms.why_severity: A probable defect that takes a particular prompt. It defeats a stop that guards the worth of a review, not the working tree.

cases: event-shaped lines in the echoed prompt are not counted
